item.title: How high is too high for speakers in your home sound system?

item.title: 40TB LTO-10 tapes quietly go on sale for $494 — a single tape can hold 13,000,000 songs and up to 100TB of compressed data with a 400MB/s transfer rate
item.description: Fujifilm's new LTO-10 tape cartridge offers 40TB native capacity, up to 100TB compressed, and 30-year archival durability for enterprises.

item.title: Venom PlayStation Portal Carry Case review: ultra-durable yet affordable
item.description: The Venom PlayStation Portal Carry Case is a very solid protective option for your remote player, offering impressive durability at an easy-to-stomach price.

item.description: Phone manufacturers are pretty direct in their guidance on this one.

item.title: Insurers claim AI is already increasing healthcare costs
